name: task-management-app
description: Task management web application with AWS CDK

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt -t .
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.deploy:frontend: cd infrastructure && npx cdk deploy TaskManagementFrontendStack
